selection_rule: Eligible candidates are ordered by canonical target subject, then stale-source commit timestamp, then candidate_id. The first four fill tc-01 through tc-04 after source-freeze validation; no treatment outcome is observed during curation.

eligible_candidates.question: For automatic CA SubjectKeyId generation when template.SubjectKeyId is empty across the Go 1.25 change, give four values in order: the current hash algorithm; the pre-Go 1.25 hash algorithm; the current key-identifier bit length; and the compatibility setting that restores the old algorithm.

For global math/rand.Seed across the Go 1.24 change, give four values in order: the current default behavior; the pre-Go 1.24 behavior; the GODEBUG key controlling the change; and the value that restores the previous behavior.

For ServeMux pattern syntax across Go 1.22, give four values in order: the current optional request-method component; the method component in Go 1.21 patterns; the current single-segment wildcard syntax; and the compatibility setting that restores Go 1.21 behavior.

eligible_candidates.canonical_target_subject: time Timer channel and Ticker garbage-collection semantics
eligible_candidates.question: For time package Timer/Ticker behavior across Go 1.23, give four values in order: the current Timer channel capacity; the pre-Go 1.23 Timer channel capacity; whether an unreferenced current Ticker is garbage-collectable; and whether an unreferenced pre-Go 1.23 Ticker was garbage-collectable.
